progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ab4 and dwells most on A in Mansoori, Pt. 2. The line peaks at Fs4 (358.3 Hz) at 0:49.7. It closes on E3, not the tonic (Fs4 → Fs4 → Fs4 → Fs4 → E3).
